licoes.objectivo: Dizer como se sente e dar e pedir conselhos com should / shouldn't e Why don't you…?

exercicios.enunciado: Complete a frase.

exercicios.enunciado: Complete a frase.
exercicios.frase: You [shouldn't] drink so much coffee at night.

exercicios.enunciado: Choose the correct sentence.

opcoes.texto: You should to see a doctor.

exercicios.enunciado: Choose the correct question.
"Should I talk to Mateus?" — Choose the answer.
"Devias ir para a cama cedo" em inglês é...

opcoes.texto: You should go to bed early.
You must go to bed early.
You have to go to bed early.

exercicios.enunciado: Which is the softest advice?
Porque é que não vais dar uma volta?
exercicios.resposta: Why don't you go for a walk?

exercicios.frase: Two a.m.? You shouldn't work so late. And you shouldn't drink so much coffee.
exercicios.enunciado: What does Sílvia say Paulo shouldn't do?

opcoes.texto: work late and drink a lot of coffee

exercicios.frase: You should rest. You shouldn't work so late.
exercicios.enunciado: Ouça e repita: o l de "should" não se diz.
I can't sleep at night. What should I do?
exercicios.frase: should
exercicios.resposta: You shouldn't drink coffee in the afternoon, and you should go to bed at the same time every day.

exercicios.enunciado: Ask me for advice about a problem at work.
exercicios.frase: What should I do
exercicios.resposta: I have a lot of work and I'm very stressed. What should I do? Should I talk to my manager?
exercicios.contexto: Diga o problema e peça um conselho.

licoes.titulo: I have to finish this today
licoes.objectivo: Dizer o que é obrigatório e o que não é necessário com have to / don't have to / had to.

exercicios.enunciado: Complete a frase.
exercicios.frase: I [have to] finish the report by Thursday.

exercicios.enunciado: Complete a frase.
exercicios.frase: Rita [has to] sign the papers before we start.

exercicios.enunciado: Complete a frase.
exercicios.frase: You [don't have to] wear a tie. There's no dress code.

exercicios.enunciado: Complete a frase.
exercicios.frase: Last Saturday I [had to] come in. We had a problem with the server.

exercicios.enunciado: Choose the correct question.

opcoes.texto: Do you have to work on Saturday?
Have you to work on Saturday?
Do you has to work on Saturday?

exercicios.enunciado: "I don't have to work on Saturday" means...

opcoes.texto: It isn't necessary to work on Saturday.
It's prohibited to work on Saturday.
I have to work on Saturday.

exercicios.enunciado: Advice or obligation? "You have to finish the report by Thursday."
Não tive de trabalhar no domingo.
exercicios.resposta: I didn't have to work on Sunday.

exercicios.frase: Yes, we have to be there at seven. Rita has to sign the papers before we start.
exercicios.enunciado: What time do they have to be at Mussulo Energy?

exercicios.frase: I have to finish the report. She has to sign the papers.
exercicios.enunciado: Ouça e repita: "have to" soa "haf-ta".
What do you have to do every day at work, and what don't you have to do?
exercicios.frase: have to
exercicios.resposta: I have to answer a lot of emails and I have to be at work at eight. I don't have to wear a suit.
exercicios.contexto: have to e don't have to.

exercicios.enunciado: Did you have to work late last week?
exercicios.frase: had to
exercicios.resposta: Yes, I had to work late on Tuesday. We had an important meeting the next day.
exercicios.contexto: had to ou didn't have to.

licoes.objectivo: Explicar regras e avisos com must / mustn't e distinguir mustn't de don't have to.

exercicios.enunciado: Complete a frase.
exercicios.frase: You [must] wear your badge at all times.

exercicios.enunciado: Complete a frase.
exercicios.frase: You [mustn't] eat or drink in the server room.

exercicios.enunciado: "You mustn't smoke here" means...

opcoes.texto: It isn't necessary to smoke here.

exercicios.enunciado: "You don't have to sign out" means...

opcoes.texto: It isn't necessary — the system does it.

exercicios.enunciado: No server room, é proibido usar o telemóvel. Choose the rule.

opcoes.texto: You mustn't use your phone in the server room.
You don't have to use your phone in the server room.
You mustn't to use your phone in the server room.

exercicios.enunciado: Não é preciso usar gravata. Choose the sentence.

opcoes.texto: You don't have to wear a tie.
You haven't to wear a tie.

exercicios.enunciado: A sign says: "In case of fire, do not use the lift." What must you do?
É proibido fumar perto do edifício.
exercicios.resposta: You mustn't smoke near the building.

exercicios.frase: You must sign in at reception every morning. You don't have to sign out — the system does it.
exercicios.enunciado: What do they have to do every morning?

exercicios.frase: You mustn't smoke here. You mustn't eat in the server room.
exercicios.enunciado: Ouça e repita: o primeiro t de "mustn't" não se diz.
Tell me two rules in your workplace with must or mustn't.
exercicios.frase: must
exercicios.resposta: You must wear your badge, and you mustn't park in the director's place.

exercicios.enunciado: Tell me one thing you don't have to do at work.
exercicios.frase: don't have to
exercicios.resposta: We don't have to wear a suit on Fridays, but we must be on time.

You sleep four hours a night.
You drink five coffees a day.

exercicios.enunciado: What should you send your manager?

How many hours do you usually sleep, and is your diet healthy?
exercicios.frase: healthy
exercicios.resposta: I usually sleep six hours. My diet isn't very healthy — I eat a lot of bread and I don't eat much fruit.

exercicios.enunciado: What do you do when you get stressed?
exercicios.frase: stressed
exercicios.resposta: When I get stressed, I go for a walk or I listen to music. I shouldn't, but sometimes I eat chocolate!

licoes.titulo: Real English: How do you stay healthy?
licoes.objectivo: Identificar o problema de cada pessoa e o conselho que recebe ou dá.

exercicios.frase: These days I don't sleep well. My doctor says I shouldn't use my phone in bed.
exercicios.enunciado: What does Rita's doctor say?

opcoes.texto: She shouldn't use her phone in bed.

exercicios.frase: So now I leave it in the kitchen. It's hard, but I sleep better.
exercicios.enunciado: Where does Rita leave her phone now?

exercicios.frase: The doctor says I have to stop the car every hour and walk for five minutes.
exercicios.enunciado: What does Tunde have to do?

opcoes.texto: stop the car every hour and walk
go to the doctor every week

exercicios.frase: My sister says I should sleep after lunch, but I can't — I have to look after the shop.
exercicios.enunciado: Why can't Fátima sleep after lunch?

opcoes.texto: She has to look after the shop.

exercicios.frase: In my first month I got sick, because I didn't drink much… — sorry — I didn't drink any water at work!
exercicios.enunciado: Why did Emma get sick?

opcoes.texto: She didn't drink any water at work.

exercicios.frase: My advice for visitors? You must drink water, all day!
exercicios.enunciado: What's Emma's advice for visitors?
"My friends think I'm crazy!" quer dizer:

opcoes.texto: Os meus amigos acham que sou maluca!

exercicios.frase: I had to stop work for a week. My doctor says I shouldn't use my phone in bed.
exercicios.enunciado: Ouça e repita em voz alta.
What do you do to stay healthy?

exercicios.resposta: I walk to work every day, and I don't drink coffee after four o'clock. At weekends I play football.

exercicios.enunciado: A colleague works twelve hours a day. What's your advice?
exercicios.frase: should
exercicios.resposta: You should take a break every two hours, and you shouldn't answer emails at night. Why don't you talk to your manager?
exercicios.contexto: Conselhos com should e Why don't you…?

licoes.titulo: Work & Life: I can't come in today

exercicios.enunciado: Complete a frase.

who can do it → the reason → you can't come
what isn't finished → the reason → goodbye

Call your manager: you're sick and you can't come in today.
